item.title: US Supreme Court strikes down swath of Trump’s global tariffs
item.description: Trump blasts six-three decision upending his economic agenda, while small businesses celebrate relief despite uncertainty over refunding billions in collected import duties The post US Supreme Court strikes down swath of Trump’s global tariffs appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: At least 12 said killed as Israel targets Hamas, Hezbollah centers in Lebanon strikes
item.description: Lebanese media say drone hit Palestinian refugee camp killing two, while 10 said killed in strike in Beqaa Valley, including senior Hezbollah official The post At least 12 said killed as Israel targets Hamas, Hezbollah centers in Lebanon strikes appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Germany’s Merz vows to keep out far-right as he warns of a changed world
item.description: At Christian Democrat party conference ahead of series of state elections, chancellor vows to not let AfD 'ruin' Germany The post Germany’s Merz vows to keep out far-right as he warns of a changed world appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Hamas says open to Gaza peacekeeping force, but rejects foreign role in ‘internal affairs’
item.description: After initially coming out strongly against US-backed stabilization force, terror group says ceasefire monitors acceptable while demanding halt to Israeli 'aggression' before 'political process' The post Hamas says open to Gaza peacekeeping force, but rejects foreign role in ‘internal affairs’ appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: US could be open to ‘token’ enrichment if Iran blocked from developing nuke — report
item.description: 'If the Iranians want to prevent an attack they should give us an offer we can’t refuse,' US official tells Axios * PA welcomes creation of formal communication channel with Board of Peace The post US could be open to ‘token’ enrichment if Iran blocked from developing nuke — report appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: In new memoir, acclaimed ‘Hairspray’ composer tells a showbiz story shaped by Jewish humor
item.description: In 'Never Mind the Happy,' Tony winner and 7-time Oscar nominee Marc Shaiman recounts collaborations with Bette Midler and Rob Reiner, and the musical liberties he took at his bar mitzvah The post In new memoir, acclaimed ‘Hairspray’ composer tells a showbiz story shaped by Jewish humor appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: South Africa pulls out of Venice Biennale after minister pans artist’s focus on Gaza
item.description: Gayton McKenzie, a staunch supporter of Israel, had alleged an unnamed foreign power wanted to use South Africa as 'a proxy to endorse a geopolitical message about Israel's actions in Gaza' The post South Africa pulls out of Venice Biennale after minister pans artist’s focus on Gaza appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Renowned Jewish mosaic artist who created Philadelphia’s Magic Gardens dies at 86
item.description: Mourning Isaiah Zagar, Magic Gardens says that he 'was more than our founder; he was our close friend, teacher, collaborator and creative inspiration' The post Renowned Jewish mosaic artist who created Philadelphia’s Magic Gardens dies at 86 appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Tucker Carlson falsely says Herzog visited Epstein island in interview with US envoy
item.description: Far-right commentator, interviewing with Huckabee, accuses Netanyahu of targeting his family, doubles down on claim Israeli security staff interrogated his team The post Tucker Carlson falsely says Herzog visited Epstein island in interview with US envoy appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Democratic candidate running for US Senate in Illinois says Israel committed ‘genocide’
item.description: Congresswoman Robin Kelly -- who previously received AIPAC donation -- slams her primary opponents for not adopting similar stance, underscoring shift on Israel among Democrats The post Democratic candidate running for US Senate in Illinois says Israel committed ‘genocide’ appeared first on The Times of Israel.
